reason: No step enters an island from the 3D world.

changes.after: [J1.5] On the World tab select the Career Placement Agents island; the right rail opens the same panel as Journeys -> Career Placement Agents, showing TRACKED (n).
changes.whyNeeded: Island entry is a primary navigation path with no scored step.

checklist.Traced: fail: the change spec (docs/changes/world-shell-opportunity-outputs.md) states no requirement that island selection opens the panel; it only names the Journeys cards path
checklist.Exact: fail: 'select the island' names no click target or position; 'TRACKED (n)' leaves n unspecified (it is 0 at this point in the journey)
checklist.Reachable: fail: islands exist only as meshes in a WebGL canvas picked by raycast on pointerdown (WorldShell.jsx lines 348-403) with no DOM element; at 390px touch there is no stated gesture
checklist.Deterministic: fail: islands orbit and drift every frame (WorldShell.jsx lines 437-441), so screen position depends on wall-clock time; headless WebGL availability is also not fixed by testConstraints

review.note: Rejected as written. This is not a product defect and does not go to the fix loop as one. If island entry must be covered, the product needs a stable, labelled DOM control per island (for example an accessible island list) so a step can name an exact target; that is a product/business decision for the owner, after which a new proposal can be reviewed. Owner question if wanted: 'Should each 3D island also be reachable through a labelled, focusable control so island entry can be tested at desktop and 390px?'
